question: A sector has a central angle of 120° and a radius of 8 cm. Another sector of the same circle has a central angle of 3π/4 radians. What is the ratio of the area of the first sector to the area of the second sector?
solution:
**Given:**

Central angle of first sector = 120°

Radius of the circle = 8 cm

Central angle of second sector = 3π/4 radians

**Formula Used:**

Area of a sector = (Central angle ÷ 360°) × π × r²

Conversion between degrees and radians: 1 radian = 180° ÷ π

**Calculation:**

⇒ Area of first sector = (120 ÷ 360) × π × (8²)

⇒ Area of first sector = (1 ÷ 3) × π × 64
